'''February 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJs Comics, Meriden, CT on 10 February 2001. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1715">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ meriden-ct-02-10-01], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' DJs Comics, Meriden, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
